ui.state_berserk_help: Off by default. When a selected template enters its last minutes without a renewal, server collection runs up to 10 probes at once, each on its own exit, until one succeeds. Each probe counts toward the hourly limit and the exit and account cooldowns.
ui.state_breakout_retry: Retry outside API key groups on State accounts
ui.state_breakout_retry_help: Off by default. When a request has no usable account left in its API key's groups (for example after CPA retries a failure), it may continue on another selected account that holds a valid template for the same model. Requires State injection and CPA request retries; the key's model permissions still apply.
ui.state_bucket_idle: Not injected: outside the collection scope or injection is off
ui.state_inject_cookies_help: Every upstream response of a selected account, including probes and degraded responses, refreshes that account's cookies in memory. While they are younger than the cookie lifetime, requests for the selected models carry them in the Cookie header, with or without a template, replacing client cookies of the same name. Saving adds a Cookie forwarding header to the selected accounts' auth files, because CLIProxyAPI does not otherwise pass Cookie to Codex.
ui.state_cookie_refresh_help: Cookies expire long before the 292 template. Every upstream response of a selected account refreshes its cookies, including probes and degraded 312 responses. After the first model in the list collects a 292, server collection probes that bucket again after this interval so the cookies stay fresh; a refresh that fails stops until the template's normal renewal. Each refresh counts toward the hourly limit.

ui.state_force_astra_help: Save to apply. Routes explicit GPT/Codex text model names through Codex accounts to gpt-6-astra, preserving reasoning effort. Custom aliases, other providers, image/audio requests and collection or quality probes keep their original routes. Independent of State injection and observation mode; to inject State, collect an Astra template for the selected account. Requires a CLIProxyAPI v7.3.4-compatible provider model router. Actual upstream usage determines billing; this does not guarantee model identity or answer quality.

ui.turn_state_proxy_help: Saved proxy URLs are shown in plain text. Saving an empty editor clears that pool. Supports HTTP, HTTPS, SOCKS5 and SOCKS5H. By default, failed static exits cool down for 55 minutes; each account/model rotating pool shares 10 attempts per 10-minute window across all URLs. Change or remove these limits under Cooldowns and retries. Buckets take turns so failed accounts do not prevent renewal. Connectivity checks and manual removal use the editor and require saving. Reachability does not guarantee collection; rotating exits may change. A successful collection restarts the budget at its next scheduled renewal. Probes advance through both pools across accounts and models, continuing after success and wrapping at the end; cooling entries are skipped. Collection logs show complete configured proxy URLs, including usernames and passwords. A gateway URL is not the actual exit IP.

ui.plan_scoped_intro: Give each API key independent balances by model or family. For example, GPT-6 gets $100 and GPT-5.5 gets $200 in separate pools.
ui.plan_scope_help: Each pool has its own reset schedule and balance for every assigned API key. All matching pools apply, including any all-model limit. Changing a pool’s model scope resets that pool’s usage.
ui.plan_scope_exact: Exact billing model IDs; one per line or separated by commas. Multiple models here share this pool. Create separate pools for independent balances.
ui.plan_scope_required: Select at least one model or family.
ui.plan_duplicate_scope_period: Another pool has the same scope and reset period.
ui.chooser_summary: {matching} matching · {selected} selected overall · {hidden} selected outside this filter
ui.chooser_bulk_help: Click an item to cycle through allowed, denied and not selected. Bulk actions affect matching items in this tab only; hidden selections stay unchanged.
ui.chooser_dynamic_help: These rules include all current and future credentials of the category. A category denial overrides individual grants. Disabled accounts remain disabled; a rule does not enable them. Bulk item selection above never changes these rules.
ui.state_intro: Collect, inspect and renew account-specific model templates.
ui.state_guide_title: Set up and verify Turn State
ui.state_guide_host: Use CLIProxyAPI 7.3.4 or a compatible host. Selected accounts use upstream HTTP/SSE; downstream WebSocket clients can use CPA's bridge.
ui.state_guide_account: Select valid Codex accounts with available quota and enter the exact upstream model IDs used by your requests. A template belongs to one account and model.
ui.state_guide_proxy: Put fixed exits in the static pool and URLs that change exit on each connection in the rotating pool. Test connectivity; reachable does not mean a valid State was collected.
ui.state_guide_injection: Enable injection and turn off Observe only. Use always when your client sends no State header. Default protection blocks business traffic for the selected models on selected accounts until a usable bucket is ready; other models skip State.
ui.state_guide_verify: Install the server collector, save all settings to verify upstream HTTP/SSE, then start collection. Confirm the collector is online and inspect bucket validity and injection counters. Finally verify a complete business response; a collected header alone does not prove stability.
ui.state_guide_more: Results, page refresh and automatic proxy removal
ui.state_guide_results: Length 312 (or your configured degraded length) is not a successful collection. Waiting for renewal, an account pause, an exit cooldown or the hourly budget does not stop an enabled collector. State does not restore exhausted account quota or guarantee response quality.
ui.state_guide_session: The server keeps collection intent and recent logs. Refreshing, leaving this tab, closing the browser or signing out does not stop collection. Stop saves a server-side stop command. If the collector or CPA restarts, the service reconnects and resumes enabled collection.
ui.state_guide_pruning: Automatic proxy removal is off by default. If enabled and saved, it immediately saves each removal while keeping at least the configured total across both pools (default 10). The separate Remove failed proxies action after a connectivity test edits the text boxes and needs Save all settings.
ui.state_runner_help: Probes consume account quota. Install the collector on your CPA server, save the collection scope, then click Start. The collector keeps working when this page closes; Stop prevents further requests after the current probe finishes.
ui.state_readiness_help: Each cell is one account × model. Use Actions to collect, test, clear cooldowns, clear a template or discard that exact State. Clearing allows relearning; discarding blocks the same State until one hour after issue. Remaining validity is shown in minutes.
ui.state_no_matching_accounts: No accounts match the current filter.
ui.state_clear_cooldown_warning: Clear all proxy and account failure cooldowns? Valid templates, normal renewal waits and the hourly budget are kept. An enabled, online collector rechecks on its next heartbeat, usually within 5 seconds; any in-flight request must finish first. A stopped task stays stopped. Retries consume quota and proxy traffic and may trigger more rate limits; clearing does not remove upstream restrictions.
ui.state_clear_bucket_cooldown_warning: Clear this bucket’s proxy cooldowns and the account pause? Clearing the account pause also affects its other models. Valid templates, normal renewal waits and the hourly budget are kept. An enabled, online collector rechecks on its next heartbeat, usually within 5 seconds; any in-flight request must finish first. A stopped task stays stopped. Retries consume quota and proxy traffic and may trigger more rate limits.
ui.state_bucket_probe_warning: Collect {model} for this account once? This consumes quota and proxy traffic and respects existing freshness and cooldown rules.
ui.state_self_test_warning: Send one real request through CPA for this account and model without injecting or learning a stored template? It consumes quota and checks connectivity only. It will not fill or replace any bucket.
ui.state_self_test_result: Self-test: {status}, state length {length}; no template collected.
ui.state_saved: Settings saved; probes use the saved collection scope.
ui.state_persistence_guidance: Some plugin paths have no independent mount, or the loaded library is missing. Container-layer files may be lost on container recreation; memory-backed files are lost on restart. Back up the database, Turn State data and plugin library, bind-mount their directories and retain plugin loading in deployment configuration. If a loaded library is missing, reinstall it before restart. Lost plugin data may remove group restrictions. Deployment volumes cannot safely be changed from this plugin.
ui.state_persistence_limits: Independent mounts were observed for some or all inspected paths. Unknown paths below still need manual verification. This check does not verify future deployments, backups or automatic plugin loading; retain those settings in deployment configuration.
ui.state_path_container_layer: No separate mount observed; may be lost when recreating the container
ui.plan_family_help: Families are identified from the billing model name, not the upstream provider. Use exact-model pools for custom aliases. Models outside every pool have no subscription cap unless an overall pool or routing restriction applies. Matching multiple pools enforces each cap; billing cost is still recorded once. Scoped plans require a concrete model name; dynamic auto selection is unsupported because the host cannot report a stable model identity.
ui.state_path_missing: Loaded library is missing on disk; reinstall before restarting CPA
ui.state_persistence_short: Some data may be lost after restart or container recreation. Review the paths and deployment instructions to protect group access rules.
ui.state_path_mounted: Independent mount observed (deployment still needs verification)
ui.state_self_test_incomplete: CPA could not complete this self-test. Check request errors, account state and model routing. This does not by itself prove the network is unreachable; no template was collected.
ui.state_discard_warning: Discard unsaved changes to accounts, models, proxy pools and strategy? Saved settings will remain.
ui.state_apply_unsaved: Unsaved changes. Save applies accounts, models, both proxy pools and strategy together. Probing uses only saved settings.
ui.state_apply_saved: All settings saved. Account/model selections and proxy changes are applied together using any Save all settings button.
ui.model_test_intro: Compare responses to the same prompt across accounts or models. Tests consume upstream quota. Checks assess this task only, not overall intelligence or the model’s true identity.
ui.model_test_billing: This is a diagnostic request through CPA’s management API. It consumes upstream quota but does not create downstream billing or usage records.
ui.model_test_select_required: Select at least one available account.
ui.model_test_batch_limit: A batch supports at most {limit} accounts. Narrow the filter or reduce your selection.
ui.model_test_batch_help: Select up to 50 accounts. Each account runs the prompt the chosen number of times, one request at a time, while different accounts run in parallel up to the concurrency limit. Failures are not retried. Stopping or leaving this tab skips pending runs and lets running requests finish.

ui.model_test_model_hint: Model suggestions belong to {account}; click an account to change the focus. The entered model is tested against every selected account, so use an ID they support.

ui.state_renewal_continuity: Early renewal does not reset the current template's expiry. A successful new template replaces it; a failed attempt keeps the old template until its original expiry. Buckets may wait for other accounts or cooldowns, and persistent upstream failures can still leave a gap.
ui.state_renewing_valid: Renewing · the existing template is still valid
ui.state_verify_completion_help: Optional and off by default. Active probes must confirm a completed SSE or JSON response within 25 seconds and 1 MiB of decoded data. Failure keeps the old valid template. This may take longer and consume more output; it does not measure answer quality.
ui.state_hourly_limit_help: A rolling hour shared by all accounts, models, pools and manual probes. Attempts are reserved before sending; failures after reservation remain counted. Saving, restarting or clearing templates does not reset it. When exhausted, collection waits while valid templates remain usable. A small limit can delay renewal.
ui.state_budget_wait: Hourly budget {used}/{limit}; waiting about {seconds}s for capacity. An enabled collector resumes automatically.
ui.state_budget_unlimited: Hourly budget is unlimited; {used} attempts reserved in the rolling hour.

ui.state_image_isolation_help: CPA image generation and edit endpoints do not require or learn conversational State. Group permissions, quotas and concurrency still apply. Image model support, uploads and timeouts are provided by CPA and the upstream.
ui.state_guide_cooldowns: HTTP 401, 403 or 429, or unreadable OAuth credentials, can pause an account across models and exits. Defaults: a 10-minute account pause, 55 minutes for a failed static exit per bucket, and 10 rotating attempts per bucket in a 10-minute window. Under Cooldowns and retries, 0 removes each limit; a zero rotating window also disables its attempt cap. Remove cooldown and attempt limits prepares a draft with all four settings and the hourly limit at 0; save to apply it. Fresh templates still wait for renewal and collection remains serial. The next check in logs is a scheduler check, not a promise to send a request then.
backend.turn_state_cooldown_invalid: Probe cooldowns must be 0 (disabled) or between 1 and 1440 minutes
backend.turn_state_rotating_attempts_inv: The rotating proxy attempt limit must be 0 (unlimited) or between 1 and 100

backend.turn_state_rate_limited_configur: The upstream rate-limited this account; probes are paused for {v0} minutes

backend.turn_state_probe_format_detail: Strict probe verification failed: expected an SSE or JSON response but got Content-Type {v0}; no template was saved

backend.turn_state_account_wait: Pending buckets are waiting for account pauses; collection will resume automatically
backend.turn_state_waiting: Pending buckets are waiting for account pauses or exit cooldowns; collection will resume automatically
ui.state_static_cooldown_help: Default: 55. After failure, the same account, model and exit wait before retrying. Direct connections follow this rule too. With 0, failures do not cool down and existing waits for these exits are ignored.
ui.state_rotating_cooldown_help: Default: 10. Rotating URLs share a window per account and model. With 0, the window is disabled and its attempt limit is not enforced, even when the attempt limit below is positive.
ui.state_rotating_max_attempts_help: Default: 10. Shared across rotating URLs for the same account and model. With 0, attempts are unlimited. A positive limit keeps attempts already used in the current window.
ui.state_account_cooldown_help: Default: 10. HTTP 401, 403 or 429, or unreadable OAuth credentials, pause all models and exits for that account. With 0, these failures and existing account waits do not cause a long pause.
ui.state_cooldown_bounds_help: Use whole minutes from 0 to 1440 and 0 to 100 attempts. Collection still runs serially with its normal 2-second scheduling interval and request timeout. Valid templates wait until renewal; a positive hourly limit still applies. Automatic proxy removal remains independent.
ui.state_cooldown_save_help: After saving, zero settings bypass the corresponding existing failure waits on the next collector heartbeat. Positive durations preserve existing deadlines; positive attempt limits preserve the count already used. Clear cooldowns can reset those waits explicitly. A stopped collector stays stopped.
ui.state_remove_limits_help: Remove cooldown and attempt limits fills these four settings and the hourly limit with 0 in your draft. Save all settings to apply it; this does not start collection or change proxy lists and automatic removal options.
ui.turn_state_proxy_check_help: Tests only the TCP connection from CPA to the proxy gateway, with a 5-second timeout and up to 10 checks at once. Sends no account or proxy credentials and does not contact OpenAI. Proxy authentication, exit IPs and collection are not tested. Gateway IP is not the exit IP. A failed result describes this attempt only; removal edits the draft and requires saving.
backend.turn_state_proxy_tcp_reachable: The proxy gateway TCP connection succeeded; authentication and outbound access were not tested
backend.turn_state_proxy_tcp_timeout: The proxy gateway TCP connection timed out
backend.turn_state_proxy_tcp_dns_failed: The proxy gateway hostname could not be resolved
backend.turn_state_proxy_tcp_failed: The proxy gateway TCP connection failed
backend.turn_state_proxy_tcp_inconclusiv: The proxy gateway TCP connection test could not be completed
ui.state_observation_help: Observes response header lengths for the exact account and model, separated by whether this plugin actually injected State. These are not success rates or model quality scores; no returned header does not prove acceptance. The last 24 hours use the current UTC hour and the preceding 23 hours. Up to 256 buckets and 100 events stay in memory and reset on restart; active collection is excluded.
ui.state_observation_empty: No response State observations. No entries does not mean no traffic: requests without plugin injection or a returned State header are not recorded.
ui.state_observation_unavailable: This plugin version did not provide response State observations.
ui.state_discard_template_warning: Discard the displayed template for {model}? This immediately removes it and blocks the same State from being learned or collected again until one hour after its original issue time, including after restart. Other templates and in-flight requests are unaffected. With no replacement, this bucket may be unavailable under the valid-State gate. Failure cooldowns and collection budgets are kept; the discarded template’s renewal wait is released.
ui.state_template_discarded: Template discarded; the same State cannot be restored during its lifetime.
backend.turn_state_discard_invalid: Account, model, and a complete template fingerprint are required to discard a template
backend.turn_state_discard_changed: The template changed or expired; refresh the table before discarding it
backend.turn_state_discard_capacity: Too many discarded templates are still valid; wait for an older discard to expire
backend.turn_state_discard_learn_blocked: The template was discarded by an administrator and will not be learned again
backend.turn_state_discard_probe_blocked: The upstream returned an administrator-discarded template; it was not saved and the next probe follows the exit pool retry rules
backend.turn_state_discard_confirm: Confirm discarding this exact template before continuing
backend.turn_state_discard_stop_runner: Stop server collection before discarding a template
ui.team_bulk_help: Select all affects the current filter. Changing filters keeps selections, including hidden accounts. The same 0–1000 limit is applied once to each selected account; 0 is unlimited. Disabled accounts can be selected when shown and stay disabled. This controls business request concurrency, not State collection concurrency.
ui.team_bulk_saved: Applied concurrency limit {limit} to {count} selected accounts.
ui.state_quality_intro: Run a few tasks against selected Codex accounts without leaving State. This spends the accounts’ upstream quota and uses saved State settings and the account/global proxy route, not the collection proxy pools. Automatic collection keeps running; these tests do not count against its hourly budget. Testing does not collect or repair State, enable accounts, or create downstream billing records.
ui.state_quality_limits: Results assess each task only, not overall intelligence or model identity. JSON, logic and Boolean tasks are selected by default; SVG and code require manual review. Requests run serially, once each. Stop or close skips pending tasks and lets the current request finish.
ui.state_quality_selection_help: Starts with the accounts selected on State. Changes here affect only this test batch; disabled accounts can be diagnosed without enabling them.
ui.state_quality_results_help: The batch stays in page memory; a new batch replaces it. Expand a result to inspect the exact answer, expected result, model declaration and proxy route. Model declarations do not prove identity or answer quality; response code is never executed.
ui.state_quality_route_pending: The proxy route is shown after preparing this request.
ui.state_quality_loading: Refreshing testable accounts and task presets…
ui.state_quality_unavailable_selected: Some selected accounts cannot be matched safely. Deselect those entries or fix their identity before starting.
ui.state_quality_limit: This selection creates {total} requests, above the limit of {limit}. Select fewer accounts or tasks.
ui.state_quality_none_available: No State accounts are currently available for these tests. Each entry shows why it cannot be used.
ui.state_quality_disabled_account: Disabled account · diagnosis only; stays disabled
ui.state_quality_original_preset: Original preset provided by this project.
ui.state_quality_state_unavailable: State account information is unavailable. Refresh State before opening these checks.
ui.state_quality_identity_unavailable: No unique supported Codex OAuth account matches this State account’s index and full credential identity. No replacement account will be used.
ui.state_quality_load_failed: Could not load test accounts and tasks. Close this dialog and try again.
ui.state_quality_selection_required: Select at least one account and one task, and enter a model ID.
backend.turn_state_suspended: Turn State is globally disabled; enable it before sending probes
ui.state_master_help: Master switch for this page. When off, Force Astra, State injection, response learning, the valid-State requirement, server collection and manual probes all stop, and business requests pass through unchanged. Saved settings, templates and cooldowns are kept and resume when you turn it back on. Applies immediately.
ui.state_master_disable_warning: Force Astra, injection, learning, the valid-State requirement and collection stop immediately; selected accounts serve requests without a template. Settings and templates are kept.
ui.state_master_on: On. The switches below apply as configured.
ui.state_master_off_unhooked: Off. The routing and response hooks are unregistered, so business requests incur no State overhead.
ui.state_master_off_hooked: Off. Every State path returns immediately. Restart CPA or reload its plugin configuration to also unregister the routing and response hooks.
ui.state_master_on_unhooked: On, but CPA loaded the plugin while State was off. Injection and the valid-State requirement work now; Force Astra and response learning need a CPA restart or plugin configuration reload.
ui.state_save_hint: Changes are saved together from the bar at the bottom.
ui.capture_intro: Select one or more upstream accounts and watch the requests CPA routes to them in real time, with their headers, bodies and responses.
ui.capture_clear_warning: Remove every captured request from plugin memory?
ui.capture_listening: Accounts listening: {count}, paused: {paused}. Capture continues while this page stays open and stops about {seconds} seconds after you leave.
ui.capture_idle: Not listening. Tick an account to start capturing. Captured requests stay in memory until cleared or CPA restarts.
ui.capture_response_hooks: Register response hooks to capture responses
ui.capture_hooks_active: Response hooks are registered; responses and streamed chunks are captured.
ui.capture_hooks_pending: Saved, but CPA has not re-registered the plugin yet, so responses are not captured. Click Reload plugin to apply.
ui.capture_hooks_off: Only requests are captured. Turning this on reloads the plugin configuration so responses are captured too; while it is on, every stream chunk passes through the plugin.
ui.capture_hooks_state: Response hooks are registered because Codex Turn State is on, so responses are captured anyway.
ui.capture_hooks_unregister: Saved. Response hooks stay registered until the plugin configuration is reloaded.
ui.capture_help_scope: Requests are shown as this plugin's hooks see them after the account is chosen: the client path, headers and body, plus the body sent upstream after protocol conversion when response hooks are available. Credentials CPA adds inside the upstream executor are not visible here.
ui.capture_help_privacy: Header values that may carry keys, tokens, cookies or passwords are redacted. Body text such as input, output and prompts is shown as *** by default. Nothing is written to disk; up to {entries} requests are kept and each body is truncated at {size}.
ui.capture_empty: No requests captured yet. After ticking an account, send a request that uses it.
ui.capture_select_hint: Select a captured request to view its full text.
ui.capture_no_response: No response was captured: response hooks were not registered yet, or the request failed before a response arrived.
ui.capture_accounts_failed: Cannot read the account list from CPA.
backend.capture_seq_required: A captured request number is required
backend.capture_not_retained: This captured request is no longer retained
backend.capture_select_account: Select an account to listen to
backend.capture_account_missing: The selected account no longer exists
backend.capture_too_many: Too many accounts are being listened to
ui.capture_hooks_apply_failed: CPA has not re-registered the plugin yet. Try again, or restart CPA.
ui.model_test_plan_too_large: {total} requests exceed the limit of {limit}; reduce accounts or runs.
ui.model_test_global_proxy: Accounts without their own proxy use the global proxy {endpoint}. Accounts with their own proxy: {count}.
ui.model_test_global_direct: No global proxy: accounts without their own proxy connect directly. Accounts with their own proxy: {count}.
ui.capture_model_mismatch: The upstream declared a different model than the request
ui.capture_chat_empty: This request contains no user or assistant messages.
ui.capture_chat_unreadable: The request body cannot be read as a conversation. It may be truncated or use an unsupported format.
